title: 第13章 团结就是力量第14章 进山
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 看到南柔向着秦关，南云起猛得指向一处废墟怒道：“看你夫君干的好事！”
南柔看向远处，当看到化为废墟的修炼室后，她不禁哑然。
这个修炼室可是南家的核心，是培养训练族人的重地，被秦关破坏了？
南柔慌张的看向秦关，这下可闯大祸了！
秦关讪讪一笑，有些不好意思道：“我真不是故意破坏的。”
刚才成功掌握体内那股白色气体的力量后，他实在是太兴奋了，因为在拳劲中融入那股力量后，直接使他的力量提升了三倍之多！
他如今这个境界，哪怕是想提升一点点力量都异常的困难，武夫不像修士，可以借助各种厉害的功法符箓等手段提升，只能单纯的去提升境界来增强力量。
一下子提升了三倍力量，这实在是让他有些兴奋过度，就算是师父看到恐怕都得惊掉下巴，那白色气体实在是太恐怖了。
“家主，不好了！”
就在这时，甲全跑了过来。
“何事？”南云起看向甲全。
甲全急忙道：
“启禀家主，大长老二长老带着家族二十多号人投奔萧家了！”
“什么！”
南云起听后不由得朝后踉跄了几步，修炼室被秦关毁掉他已经备受打击，此刻听到两名长老带着二十多人叛变，他整个人差点晕过去。
一旁的南家人也是有些震惊，南家总共就三十余人，大长老二长老竟然带走了二十多个，南家怕是要完了。
“父亲！”南柔急忙上前搀扶着南云起，用手帕给他擦了擦脸上的冷汗。
“家主，昨日杨傲也是投靠了萧家！”这时，甲全又说了一句。
他的意思很明显，大长老二长老一定是经杨傲投奔萧家的。
“嗯，这件事应该是和杨傲有很大的关系，不过大长老二长老一直不服我这个家主，他们迟早会有动静。”
稍微冷静下来的南云起点头道，此刻他似乎苍老了许多，南家难道真要在他手里没落了吗？
“秘境还有两天开启，他们这时候投靠萧家，算盘打得好啊！”这时一名南家弟子沉声道。
闻言，周围的南家族人纷纷点头，到时候秘境一开，里面的好处自然是强者得之，萧家在鹿云城那可是顶尖势力。
“甲全，把所有的族人召集过来，老夫有话要说。”南云起面色凝重道。
“是！”甲全转身离开。
“爹，发生什么了？”这时，南乔急忙从远处走了过来，与她一起的还有杨红梅。
杨红梅经过昨天一事后，明显没有先前那么咋咋呼呼了，此刻沉默的像个木头人。
“大长老二长老带着二十多个南家人叛逃了。”南云起沉声道。
“我早就料到他们有问题。”南乔听后倒是没感到太大意外。
看到满面愁容的南云起，杨红梅有些心疼，突然来到他身旁轻声道：“老爷，昨日都是我不好，你要保重身体。”
昨晚，南乔开导了她一夜，南乔说她一直不尊重父亲，从来不顾及父亲的脸面，从来没有把父亲当做一家之主，父亲才会受不了爆发的。
南乔让她主动与父亲低个头，这件事还有缓和的余地。
经过一夜的思考，杨红梅也有所醒悟。
见到杨红梅主动低头，南云起心里颇为诧异，不过他并没有理会她，也没那个心思理会。
不一会，南家剩下的十几个族人都被甲全叫了过来。
content_en:
Seeing Nan Rou heading towards Qin Guan, Nan Yun pointed at a ruin and said angrily: "Look at the good deeds your husband has done!"
Nanrou looked into the distance, and when she saw the training room turned into ruins, she couldn't help but become speechless.
This training room is the core of the Nan family and an important place for cultivating and training clan members. Was it destroyed by Qin Guan?
Nanrou looked at Qin Guan in panic, she was in big trouble now!
Qin Guan smiled and said a little embarrassedly: "I really didn't do it on purpose."
After successfully mastering the power of the white gas in his body just now, he was really excited, because after integrating that power into his fist strength, his strength was directly increased by three times!
In his current state, it is extremely difficult to increase even a little bit of strength. Unlike monks, warriors can use various powerful techniques, talismans and other means to improve. They can only simply improve their state to increase their strength.
His strength was increased by three times at once, which really made him a little too excited. Even the master would be shocked when he saw it. The white gas was really terrifying.
"Master, it's not good!"
At this moment, Jia Quan ran over.
"What's the matter?" Nan Yunqi looked at Jia Quan.
Jiaquan said hurriedly:
"Reporting to the head of the family, the first elder and the second elder have defected to the Xiao family with more than 20 members of the family!"
"What!"
After hearing this, Nan Yunqi couldn't help but stumbled back a few steps. He was already devastated by the destruction of the training room by Qin Guan. At this moment, when he heard that two elders led more than 20 people to rebel, he almost fainted.
The Nan family on the side was also a little shocked. There were only more than thirty people in the Nan family, and the first elder and the second elder actually took away more than twenty people. The Nan family was afraid that it was going to be doomed.
"Father!" Nan Rou hurriedly stepped forward to help Nan Yunqi, and wiped the cold sweat on his face with a handkerchief.
"Master, Yang Ao also defected to the Xiao family yesterday!" At this time, Jia Quan said again.
His meaning was obvious. The first elder and the second elder must have defected to the Xiao family through Yang Ao.
"Well, this matter should have a lot to do with Yang Ao, but the first elder and the second elder have always been dissatisfied with me as the head of the family. Sooner or later they will make some move."
After calming down a little, Nan Yun nodded and said. He seemed much older now. Is the Nan family really going to decline in his hands?
"The secret realm will open in two days. It's a good idea for them to join the Xiao family now!" At this time, a Nan family disciple said solemnly.
Hearing this, the surrounding Nan family members nodded. When the secret realm is opened, the benefits inside will naturally be obtained by the strong. The Xiao family is the top power in Luyun City.
"Jiaquan, call all the clan members here, I have something to say." Nan Yunqi said with a solemn expression.
"Yes!" Jia Quan turned and left.
"Dad, what happened?" At this time, Nan Qiao hurriedly walked over from a distance, and with her was Yang Hongmei.
After yesterday's incident, Yang Hongmei was obviously not as fussy as before. She was as silent as a wooden person at the moment.
"The first elder and the second elder defected with more than twenty Nan family members." Nan Yunqi said in a deep voice.
"I had expected that they would have problems." Nan Qiao was not too surprised after hearing this.
Seeing Nan Yunqi with a sad face, Yang Hongmei felt a little distressed. She suddenly came to his side and whispered: "Master, it was all my fault yesterday. You have to take care of yourself."
Last night, Nan Qiao enlightened her all night. Nan Qiao said that she had always disrespected her father, never cared about his father's face, and had never regarded her father as the head of the family, so her father couldn't bear it and exploded.
Nan Qiao asked her to take the initiative to bow her head to her father. There was still room for relaxation in this matter.
After a night of thinking, Yang Hongmei also woke up.
Seeing Yang Hongmei lowering her head proactively, Nan Yunqi was quite surprised, but he didn't pay attention to her, and he didn't have the intention to do so.
After a while, the remaining dozen or so clan members of the Nan family were all called over by Jia Quan.
